title: Anthropic sues Defense Department over supply-chain risk designation
description: Anthropic filed suit against the Department of Defense on Monday after the agency labeled it a supply chain risk. The complaint calls the DOD's actions "unprecedented and unlawful."
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Qualcomm’s partnership with Neura Robotics is just the beginning
description: Neura Robotics is going to build new robots on top of Qualcomm's new IQ10 processors that were released at CES.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: Sandberg, Clegg join Nscale board as this ‘Stargate Norway’ startup hits $14.6B  valuation
description: Nvidia-backed British AI infrastructure startup Nscale has raised another megaround of $2 billion.

title: Will the Pentagon’s Anthropic controversy scare startups away from defense work?

title: Owner of ICE detention facility sees big opportunity in AI man camps
